title: What If You Got $100 Every Time Someone Ignored You?

shots.label: MONDAY
shots.vo: Nico was the kind of kid people looked straight through.
Hey, Jade! Nice jacket!
She didn't even turn around. Then his phone buzzed.
A deposit. One hundred dollars. From a bank he had never heard of.
Reason... you were ignored? What kind of bank is this?
Probably a scam. Somebody at this school is messing with me.
But the money was real. He checked three times.

shots.label: FIRST PERIOD
shots.vo: Can I borrow a pencil?
Chase didn't even look up from his phone.
Wait. Every time someone ignores me... I get paid?

shots.label: LUNCH
shots.vo: So at lunch, he ran an experiment.
He said hi to every single table. Nobody answered.
Twelve hundred dollars. In four minutes.

shots.label: AFTER SCHOOL
shots.vo: On the way home, he waved at strangers. Every single one walked past.

shots.label: THAT NIGHT
shots.vo: By midnight, he had four thousand three hundred dollars.
Being invisible was the worst thing about my life. Now it's my job.
Tomorrow, I'm getting ignored like a professional.
There was just one line of small print he didn't read.
And he had already come up with a terrible idea.

shots.label: TUESDAY
shots.vo: Nico had four thousand dollars and one simple plan.
If people ignore boring people... I just have to be the most boring person alive.

shots.label: FIRST PERIOD
shots.vo: Did you know that sand is just very small rocks?
The whole class tuned him out at the same time.
Bro... you okay? You've been weird since yesterday.
Omar was his best friend. Omar never ignored him. Which meant Omar was bad for business.
I'm busy, Omar. Go sit somewhere else.

shots.label: AFTER SCHOOL
shots.vo: Then he went big. He texted every number in his phone.
Two hundred and fourteen people. Left on read.
Nico. Why is there a gaming PC in the hallway?
It's... a school project, Ava. Don't touch it.
You're being weird. And your hand looks kinda... see-through.
He laughed it off. Must have been the light.

shots.label: WEDNESDAY
shots.vo: The next morning, he showed up in four hundred dollar sneakers.
Nice shoes. Wait. Who even are you?
And then the most popular girl in school looked straight at him.
And for the first time all week... she didn't ignore him.
Jade walked right up to him. Nico had thirty thousand dollars and zero idea what to say.
You said you liked my jacket on Monday. Sorry I didn't answer. I had my headphones in.
Oh. Uh. Yeah. It's... a really good jacket.
They talked for ten minutes. And for ten minutes, his phone was completely silent.
Then he noticed something. His hand wasn't see-through anymore.
And his bank had noticed too.
Being noticed costs me money?
Five hundred dollars for ten minutes of talking. The bank was keeping score.
So... a few of us are going to the movies Friday. Want to come?
The girl he'd liked for two years. Or thirty thousand dollars.
Sorry. I'm busy.
He walked away. He didn't look back.
Jade stood there for a long time.
Okay. Got it. I guess I'm not worth his time.

shots.label: WALKING HOME
shots.vo: He told himself he made the right choice. Thirty thousand dollars said he did.

shots.label: THAT NIGHT
shots.vo: That night, Nico couldn't stop checking the app.
Then a message he had never seen before.
A thousand people. At the same time.
And he knew exactly where to find them.

shots.label: SATURDAY
shots.vo: Where do a thousand people ignore you at the same time? The internet.
Hi. This is a video of me. Watching paint dry. Part one of forty.
He posted it. And people scrolled. And scrolled. And scrolled.
Forty eight thousand people swiped past him in one hour.
I'm a millionaire. I'm a millionaire! For being boring!
So he posted another one. And another. Forty boring videos in one weekend.

shots.label: SUNDAY
shots.vo: Two point one million dollars. He bought a car he couldn't drive and a watch he couldn't read.
Ava, honey, where's your brother? Dinner's ready.
Mom, I'm right here.
Mom looked right at him. Then right through him.
One hundred dollars. From his own mom.
Nico? Is that you? You look like a ghost.

shots.label: MIDNIGHT
shots.vo: That night, someone knocked on his bedroom window. From the outside.
A man in a black suit. On the second floor.
Good evening, Nico. I'm from the bank. We need to talk about your account.
Because every dollar has to come from somewhere.
The Banker sat on the edge of Nico's bed like he owned it.
You've been paid two million dollars. Do you know what you paid with?
Nothing. People ignored me. That's free.
Every time someone ignores you, a little bit of you stops existing for them. We buy that part.
At zero percent, nobody can see you. Not your friends. Not your family. Not even a camera.
Then I'll stop. I'll give it all back.
No refunds. You can only earn your way back. The hard way.
And just like that, he was gone. Only a business card on the bed.
The card had one sentence on it.

banner.text: ATTENTION CAN'T BE BOUGHT. ONLY GIVEN.

shots.label: MONDAY
shots.vo: Monday. Nico walked into school, and nobody moved out of his way.
People bumped into him and apologized to the air.
Weird. Felt like I walked into a ghost.
Every bump paid a hundred dollars. And every dollar made it worse.

shots.label: LUNCH
shots.vo: Then he saw Omar. Sitting alone. At their old table.
Omar looked up. Right at him.
Nico? Why are you see-through?
Out of the whole school, only Omar could still see him clearly.
You can see me? Like, really see me?
Of course I can. You ignored me for a week, man. I never stopped looking out for you.
So Nico told him everything. The bank. The money. The Banker.
Two million dollars? And you didn't even buy me a sandwich?
Omar, focus. Attention can't be bought, only given. What does that even mean?
Easy. Then buy it anyway. You're rich. Make everyone look at you.

shots.label: PLAN A
shots.vo: So Plan A. He rented the biggest billboard in the city.
Ten thousand people drove past it. Not one of them cared.
Plan A made him another million dollars. And cost him five percent.

shots.label: PLAN B
shots.vo: Plan B. He threw the biggest party the school had ever seen.
Three hundred people came. For the free pizza. Nobody asked whose party it was.
Best party ever! Who even threw this? Whatever!

shots.label: MIDNIGHT
shots.vo: Nico ended up on the roof. Alone. Thirty percent of him already gone.
Then the door opened behind him.
I knew it was your party. I could feel it. I just can't see you very well.
She was the girl he had ignored. And she had still come looking for him.
Jade sat down next to the blurry shape that used to be Nico.
I said I was busy. I wasn't. I chose money over you.
I know. Everybody ignored me in middle school. I know what it does to you.
And as she talked, Nico did something he hadn't done in weeks. He actually listened.
And something changed.
Wait. When I pay attention to someone else... I come back?
Attention can't be bought. Only given. That's... actually kind of beautiful.

shots.label: NEXT MORNING
shots.vo: So Nico made a new plan. He called it Plan C.
Plan C. See the people nobody sees. I love it. Who's first?

shots.label: PLAN C
shots.vo: First, the lunch lady who'd served him every day for three years.
Hey. Your mac and cheese is the only reason I survive Mondays. Thank you.
Then the kid who always ate alone. Then the janitor. Then the new girl.
Every real conversation cost him money. And gave him back a little piece of himself.

shots.label: THAT EVENING
shots.vo: Nico! There you are. I feel like I haven't seen you in weeks.
He hugged her for a long time. It cost him ten thousand dollars. Worth it.
Everything was finally getting better. Until Ava came in holding her phone.
Nico. Why is Chase posting a video of your see-through hand?
Chase had filmed him at the party. Half invisible. Right in front of the camera.
Three point eight million views. Everyone is looking at me.
And millions of people paying attention at once did something the bank never planned for.
He was fully visible. For the first time in weeks.
I'm back! I'm completely back!

shots.label: NEXT DAY
shots.vo: The next day, the whole school was waiting for him.
But they weren't saying hi. They were filming.
Do the ghost thing! Come on, ghost kid! Disappear for the camera!
Everyone was staring at him. And somehow, he felt more invisible than ever.
Because they were looking at the ghost. Not at Nico.
Attention is not the same as being seen, Nico. Didn't you read the card?
Then what's the difference?!
A million strangers can watch you. Only the people who matter can see you.
And your account has a problem. You have three days left.

shots.label: THAT NIGHT
shots.vo: What happens when it closes?
Whatever's left of you... becomes ours.

shots.label: 72 HOURS LEFT
shots.vo: Seventy two hours. Nico needed a plan. And he needed help.
I need to tell you guys something. All of it.
He told them about the bank, the Banker, and the seventy two hours.
So the bank pays you when people ignore you. What happens if you ignore the bank?
Nobody had ever thought of that.
The Banker comes when you open the app, right? So delete it. Starve it.
If I delete it, I lose everything. Every dollar.
You had twelve dollars and us before. You were fine.
Nico looked at his phone. Three thousand dollars left. Then at the three people who could see him.
Okay. Let's starve it.
The second his thumb touched delete, every light in the house went out.
And the Banker was standing in the living room.
Close the account, and you close yourself. You'll vanish tonight.
You said only the people who matter can see me.
Omar stepped forward. Then Jade. Then Ava.
And they're all looking right at me.
Four people. Looking at one boy. Not filming. Not scrolling. Just seeing him.
And it was worth more than anything the bank had ever paid him.
Impossible. Nobody walks away from two million dollars.
Watch me.
He pressed delete. And for the first time, Nico ignored the bank.
The Banker flickered. Like a bad signal.
You'll regret this, Nico.
Then the lights came back on. The money was gone. The car was gone. The watch was gone.
So... you're broke again. Can I at least get that sandwich?

shots.label: ONE WEEK LATER
shots.vo: One week later, Nico had twelve dollars. Exactly what he started with.
So. Movies on Friday. You're not busy this time, right?
Not busy. Never again.

shots.label: LATER
shots.vo: And when he saw someone sitting alone, he always said hi. Every single time.
But across the hall, Chase was trying to get someone's attention. Nobody looked up.
Then his phone buzzed.
The bank always finds a new customer. Would you have deleted it?
